mentions.name: clingon
mentions.description: An interactive terminal workflow tool that functions as a command cheat sheet with its own built-in shell and composable workflow recipes, all backed by markdown. Commands and recipes stay human-readable while remaining executable by anyone or anything, and Warnings or Cautions in the markdown surface as warnings and cautions when running commands in the shell.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m also working on an interactive terminal workflow tool, it’s not quite ready for the world.

It’s effectively an interactive command cheat sheet with its own built in shell, and compostable workflow recipes, all backed by markdown. So your commands and recipes can be read by humans, and executed by anyone (or anything).

Warnings or Cautions in markdown become warnings and cautions when running commands in the shell.
mentions.author: purple-leafy
